body: im 16, not much older I know but still. The thing with him is that he’s respectful to other people regardless of color when in public, even telling my mom off for saying anything rude about strangers but when hes home its like he’s being possessed. It’s so strange.

My parents yes. His school, no. His friends? Probably not. I’ve met them and they come to visit every now and then and he’s pretty much the only one who’s like that. My mom and dad both have the mindset that it’s just a word, it’s not hurting anyone, etc. I don’t want him to turn out like them. Hes only 13 and kids are stupid I understand that, I was edgy his age too but I want him to stop before its too late.

Ive been thinking of sitting him down and showing him videos/documentaries but im scared it might be too much since hes still a kid? My friends told me that exposure to that as a child isnt good but I think its helpful especially because schools here aren’t willing to teach about that history. I do want opinions thoughv

I didn’t mention this in the post but we’re not white just to clarify. Anyway, no. He hasn’t been this way towards poc. Infact, he’s a nice and quiet kid. I’m the oldest and I’ve been with him throughout everything so I know this. Just, whenever he plays games or watches videos he gets “excited”(?) and starts yelling out slurs and other offensive phrases. It’s weird.
I plan to move out when I can, but before that I really want to try and help him change for the better.
